metadata.case_name: FAN HUNG SHING v. HANG FUNG SHIPPING COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: crane operator on board a barge
plaintiff.occupation_after: intermittently as a shop assistant, checker/ticker collector, watchman, and steersman; from April 1999 checker/watchman on a construction site (not full-time, 13-22 days/month, 8-hour day)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: crane driver on a construction site (would probably have worked as a crane driver until age 60)

injuries.description: A compression fracture of the 2nd lumbar vertebra
source: A compression fracture of the 2nd lumbar vertebra

injuries.description: a fracture of the left medial malleolus
source: a fracture of the left medial malleolus
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: a fracture of the right os calcis
source: a fracture of the right os calcis

manifestations.description: frequent attacks of back pain radiating to the left buttock
stiffness and weakness of the back
pain and stiffness in the right back aggravated by long standing and walking on uneven ground
has to wear special shoes by reason of the right foot condition
some minimal discomfort over the left ankle
surgical scarring of his back and both feet
unable to do any work involving heavy lifting, walking on uneven surfaces, standing for long periods, or use of ladders; walks with a mild limp
disturbance of sleep and discomfort in daily life

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenity including frequent back pain, stiffness, weakness, inability to do heavy lifting, walking on uneven surfaces, standing for long periods, use of ladders, mild limp and disturbance of sleep
Unable to walk on uneven surfaces, stand for long periods or use ladders; walks with a mild limp
Surgical scarring of his back and both feet
Unable to return to work as a crane driver; restricted to essentially sedentary jobs and intermittent work
